claude.rationale: The slice documents realized financial deterioration (four consecutive fiscal-year net losses, multiple large impairment provisions, and portfolio-realignment dispositions of 26 properties for $242.3M), but none of this evidence describes disruption at a product/process interface (product-line vs. operations incoherence), so p4 is coded 0. Likewise, there is no documented fracture between operations and people/management/culture — operations were run continuously by the external business manager for a $40M fee with no reported organizational break — so p5 is coded 0. The slice gives no evidence about the controlling-intent archetype (t1) or reconciliation of two business models (t2), so those are uncertain.
